LanguageData.MST.turretConfigComment: Click to open the turret config window: the main gun is shown for CompProperties_VehicleWeapon, and each sub-turret slot for CompPropertiesMultipleTurretGun.subTurrets. Fields are edited in place; slots are never added or removed.
LanguageData.MST.turretConfigIntro: Sub-turret slots are shown per the Def's actual config; adding/removing slots and renaming IDs are not supported. Scalars (warmup / angles / auto attack) apply immediately; changing the turret weapon only affects newly spawned or re-initialized units.
LanguageData.MST.turretSlotsComment: Editable snapshot of sub-turret slots (only the fields below). Apply merges by slot ID in place; render config stays on the Def.
LanguageData.MST.turretNoSlots: This unit has no sub-turret slots.
LanguageData.MST.turretComment: The fixed sub-turret weapon for this slot. Only affects newly spawned or re-initialized units; existing sub-turrets keep their current weapon.
LanguageData.MST.warmingTimeComment: Warmup time before firing (seconds). Read live; changes apply immediately.
LanguageData.MST.angleOffsetComment: Extra rotation while aiming (degrees). DMS commonly uses -90.
LanguageData.MST.idleAngleOffsetComment: Extra idle rotation when there is no target (degrees).
LanguageData.MST.autoAttackComment: Whether the turret acquires targets automatically. When off, targets must be assigned manually. Read live.
LanguageData.MST.supportedWeaponTagComment: Weapon tag (weaponTags) allowed to be mounted in this slot. Empty means a fixed weapon.
LanguageData.MST.generateWithWeaponsComment: Weapon tags randomly chosen for this slot on NPC generation. Only affects future spawns.
LanguageData.MST.turretMainNote: The default weapon is only used when a unit spawns without a primary weapon or when a repair replaces a missing weapon; it never replaces an existing primary. Rotation and draw size are read every frame.
LanguageData.MST.vehicleDefaultWeaponComment: Weapon used when spawning without a primary, or when a repair restores a missing weapon. Never replaces an existing primary.
LanguageData.MST.vehicleTurretRotationFollowPawnComme: Whether the main gun follows the pawn's facing. Read live.
LanguageData.MST.vehicleRotationSmoothTimeComment: Smoothing time for main-gun rotation (seconds); lower is snappier. Read live.
LanguageData.MST.vehicleDrawSizeComment: Draw scale of the main gun. Read live.
